title: GSSK Model
description: Schema for General Systems Simulation Kernel (GSSK) models. Based on Odum's Energy Systems Language. Each inter-block connection carries four channels (Odum 2000, Appendix A): Code (carrier), Force (driving potential, implicit in logic+Q), Flow (rate, computed by logic), and Transformity (quality ratio, computed from quality_input).

nodes.description: Ordered array of compartments. The index of each node here is its column index in GSSK_GetState().

edges.description: Directed flows between nodes. Omit for a single isolated storage.

Metadata.description: Model provenance and versioning. schema_version is required in production.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Kernel rejects models with unsupported versions.

Node.description: A compartment (storage, source, sink, or constant reference value).

id.description: Unique identifier. Max 63 chars (C internal limit). Stable across model mutations.

type.description: storage: dQ/dt computed. source/constant: Q fixed at value. sink: accumulates inflows, not depleted.

value.description: Initial state Q at t_start, or fixed value for source/constant nodes.

quality_input.description: Odum Position 4 (Transformity) at system boundary. Solar transformity convention: 1.0 for solar. Set on source/constant nodes to enable the quality accounting pass. Units are domain-defined (e.g. sej/J, sej/$, or dimensionless). Omit to disable quality accounting for this source.

output_mode.description: How quality propagates at bifurcations from this node. partition: quality divides proportionally to flow (Bastianoni split). replicate: each downstream branch receives the full quality (Bastianoni co-product). Does NOT affect ODE integration.

visual.description: UI layout hints. Ignored by the kernel.

Edge.description: A directed flow between two nodes. Implements Odum's four-position inter-block connection: carrier (Code), logic+Q (Force+Flow), quality_input on origin node (Transformity).

id.description: Stable identifier. Required for GSSK_SetEdgeK(), GSSK_DeactivateEdge(), and coupled_edge references.

origin.description: ID of the node the flow leaves.

target.description: ID of the node the flow enters.

carrier.description: Odum Position 1 (Code): what substance or entity is flowing. Free string — use domain conventions: 'energy', 'money', 'material', 'information', 'force', or specific types ('H2O', 'GBP', 'bits'). Does NOT affect ODE integration. Used by quality accounting pass and UI.

logic.description: Flow calculation type. Encodes Odum Position 2 (Force) and Position 3 (Flow) jointly.

output_mode.description: Quality propagation mode for this specific edge. Overrides the origin node's output_mode for this edge only.

coupled_edge.description: ID of a paired counter-flow edge. Used to model commodity-payment pairs where money flows opposite to goods (e.g. 'salary_payment' coupled with 'labour_delivery'). Kernel uses this for quality accounting directionality.

visual.description: UI layout hints. Ignored by the kernel.

k.description: Conductance/rate coefficient. Modifiable at runtime via GSSK_SetEdgeK(). For constant logic: flow = k. For linear: flow = k × Q_origin.

control_node.description: Required for interaction and limit logic. ID of the node whose Q value modulates the flow.

threshold.description: Required for threshold logic. Flow = k if Q_origin > threshold, else 0.

Config.description: Simulation parameters. All fields optional — defaults shown.

t_end.description: Simulation end time. Must be > t_start.

method.description: Integration method. auto: kernel selects incipient where eligible (all-constant/linear/interaction edges), RK4 otherwise, with dual-solver verification. euler/rk4: force specific solver (debugging). incipient: force IDC (testing only — falls back to RK4 for limit/threshold edges).

solver_tolerance.description: Maximum relative error between IDC and RK4 before dual-solver confidence degrades to DEGRADED and k-adjustments are frozen. Only used in auto mode.
